description: Use this when the user wants a readable round-up of recent findings: what happened this week in aging research, the notable results in a field, or a short list for a journal club. Lists the stories AgingResearch.News wrote about new papers, newest first, each checked against its paper: a plain-language headline, body, why it matters and caveats, with the paper. Narrow by category, body system, study type or publication date. Only the papers chosen for a story; for every paper on a question use search_papers.

category.description: Category slug. A paper matches when its category or its secondary category is listed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page. Keep the other parameters the same.

since.description: Only stories published on or after this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

system.description: Body system key (see `systems`). A paper matches when it involves any of them.

until.description: Only stories published on or before this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: list_stories
